add-link-and-text-annotations.title: Add Link and Text Annotations and Retrieve Link Destination

add-highlight-annotation-export-xfdf__v2.title: Add Highlight Annotation and Export to XFDF

add-figure-annotation-export-xfdf.title: Add Figure Annotation and Export to XFDF
add-figure-annotation-export-xfdf.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, adding a square (figure) annotation, exporting all annotations to XFDF via a MemoryStream, and saving the modified PDF.

add-sticky-note-and-export-xfdf.title: Add Sticky Note Annotation and Export to XFDF
add-sticky-note-and-export-xfdf.description: Demonstrates how to add a text (sticky note) annotation to a PDF, save the document, and then export the annotations to XFDF using a memory stream.

add-text-annotation-to-pdf-page__v4.title: Add Text Annotation to PDF Page

delete-all-annotations-from-page-4.title: Delete All Annotations from Page 4

add-freetext-annotation-default-appearan.title: Add FreeText Annotation with Default Appearance to PDF

add-line-annotation-with-popup.title: Add Line Annotation with Popup to PDF

add-multiple-text-annotations-to-pdf.title: Add Multiple Text Annotations to PDF Pages
add-multiple-text-annotations-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to create and add several TextAnnotation objects with titles and contents to different pages of a PDF document and then save the annotated file.

create-freetext-callout-annotation__v2.title: Create FreeText Callout Annotation with Arrow

add-centered-freetext-annotation.description: Demonstrates how to create a FreeTextAnnotation, set its text alignment to centered, and save the modified PDF document.

add-invisible-freetext-annotation.description: Demonstrates how to create a FreeTextAnnotation with invisible flags (Print | NoView) on a PDF page and save the modified document using Aspose.Pdf.

add-line-annotation-with-popup__v2.description: Demonstrates creating a line annotation, attaching a popup annotation with custom contents, and saving the modified PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-polyline-annotation-to-pdf__v2.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, creating an orange polyline annotation titled "Route" with 70% opacity, adding it to the first page, and saving the result as a new file.

add-swf-screen-annotation-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to load an existing PDF, create a ScreenAnnotation that references a local SWF file, place it on the first page, and save the updated document.

add-sound-annotation-with-popup.title: Add Sound Annotation with Popup to PDF Page
add-sound-annotation-with-popup.description: Shows how to load a PDF, embed a WAV file as a SoundAnnotation on page 2, set a custom color and title, attach a PopupAnnotation, and save the updated document.

add-rich-media-annotation-with-custom-pl.title: Add Rich Media Annotation with Custom Player to PDF
add-rich-media-annotation-with-custom-pl.description: Shows how to place a RichMediaAnnotation on a specific PDF page and attach a custom SWF player, using reflection to handle version differences.

add-rich-media-annotation-with-custom-fl.title: Add Rich Media Annotation with Custom Flash Variables to PDF
add-rich-media-annotation-with-custom-fl.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, creating a RichMediaAnnotation on page 3, setting custom Flash variables (using reflection for version compatibility), updating the annotation, and saving the modified document.

add-rich-media-annotation-with-poster.title: Add Rich Media Annotation with Poster Image to PDF
add-rich-media-annotation-with-poster.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, creating a RichMediaAnnotation on page 3, assigning a poster image, updating the annotation, and saving the modified document.

extract-screen-annotation-references.title: Extract Screen Annotation File References from PDF Page
extract-screen-annotation-references.description: Loads a PDF, accesses page 4, collects the file references stored in ScreenAnnotation objects, and writes them to a text file.

extract-sound-annotation-titles-to-csv.title: Extract Sound Annotation Titles from PDF Page to CSV
extract-sound-annotation-titles-to-csv.description: Loads a PDF, retrieves all SoundAnnotation objects on page 5, and writes their titles into a CSV file.

remove-richmedia-annotations-from-pdf-pa.title: Remove RichMedia Annotations from a PDF Page
remove-richmedia-annotations-from-pdf-pa.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, access page 6, delete all RichMediaAnnotation objects, and save the modified document.

add-3d-u3d-annotation-to-pdf.title: Add 3D U3D Annotation to PDF Page
add-3d-u3d-annotation-to-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF, embed a U3D model as a PDF3DAnnotation on page 7, configure a view and border, and save the updated document.

add-3d-annotation-with-custom-lighting.title: Add 3D Annotation with Custom Lighting to PDF Page
add-3d-annotation-with-custom-lighting.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, creating a PDF3DAnnotation with a lighting scheme and render mode, placing it on page 8, and saving the modified document.

add-watermark-annotation-to-pdf-page.title: Add Watermark Annotation with Opacity to PDF Page
add-watermark-annotation-to-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, creating a WatermarkAnnotation with 50% opacity and custom text on page 9, and saving the modified document.

reuse-single-image-across-multiple-pdf-p.title: Reuse Single Image Across Multiple PDF Pages
reuse-single-image-across-multiple-pdf-p.description: Shows how to load an existing PDF, ensure it has at least three pages, and place the same image on each of the first three pages using XImageCollection.Add, then save the updated document.

add-page-navigation-buttons-to-pdf.title: Add Page Navigation Buttons to PDF
add-page-navigation-buttons-to-pdf.description: Loads a PDF, creates LinkAnnotation buttons on page 12 for First, Previous, Next, and Last page navigation, and saves the updated document.

enumerate-annotations-on-pdf-page.title: Enumerate Annotations on a PDF Page
enumerate-annotations-on-pdf-page.description: Loads a PDF, verifies it has at least 14 pages, accesses page 14, iterates over any annotations on that page, and saves the (unchanged) document.

add-blue-text-watermark-to-pdf-page-15.title: Add Blue Text Watermark to PDF Page 15
add-blue-text-watermark-to-pdf-page-15.description: The example loads a PDF, creates a WatermarkAnnotation with blue 24‑point text on page 15, and saves the modified document.

add-sound-annotation-with-popup__v2.title: Add Sound Annotation with Popup to PDF Page
add-sound-annotation-with-popup__v2.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, creating a SoundAnnotation titled "Background Music" with a popup window on page 2, and saving the modified document.

add-rich-media-annotation-to-pdf.title: Add Rich Media Annotation to PDF Page
add-rich-media-annotation-to-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF, create a RichMediaAnnotation on page 16, attach a SWF media file and a poster image using reflection for version‑agnostic support, and save the modified document.

extract-embedded-media-from-richmedia-an.title: Extract Embedded Media from RichMedia Annotations
extract-embedded-media-from-richmedia-an.description: Loads a PDF, locates RichMediaAnnotation objects on a specific page, and extracts each embedded media stream to separate files on disk.

remove-watermark-annotations-from-page.title: Remove Watermark Annotations from a Specific PDF Page
remove-watermark-annotations-from-page.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, locate WatermarkAnnotation objects on a given page, delete them, and save the modified document.

add-watermark-annotations-varying-opacit.title: Add Watermark Annotations with Varying Opacity to PDF Pages
add-watermark-annotations-varying-opacit.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, creating WatermarkAnnotation objects with different opacity values for pages 18‑20, and saving the modified document.

add-3d-annotation-to-pdf-page.title: Add 3D Annotation to PDF Page
add-3d-annotation-to-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to embed a U3D/PRC 3‑D model into a PDF as a PDF3DAnnotation on a specific page using Aspose.Pdf.

add-image-watermark-to-page-24.title: Add Image Watermark to Specific PDF Page
add-image-watermark-to-page-24.description: Shows how to load a PDF, verify it has at least 24 pages, and apply an image watermark with 30% opacity to page 24 using Aspose.Pdf.

reuse-image-across-multiple-pdf-pages.title: Reuse Image Across Multiple PDF Pages
reuse-image-across-multiple-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, adding an image to the document's resources once, and reusing that shared image on five pages before saving the result.

add-caret-annotation-to-pdf.title: Add Red Caret Annotation to PDF Page
add-caret-annotation-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, creating a red caret annotation with a title on the first page, and saving the modified document.

extract-caret-annotation-rectangles.title: Extract Caret Annotation Rectangles from a PDF Page
extract-caret-annotation-rectangles.description: Loads a PDF, accesses page 3, filters for CaretAnnotation objects, and writes each annotation's rectangle coordinates to a text file.

remove-caret-annotation-from-pdf.title: Remove Specific Caret Annotation from PDF
remove-caret-annotation-from-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF, locate a CaretAnnotation titled "Obsolete" on a given page, delete it, and save the modified document.

add-hidden-caret-annotation-to-pdf-page-.title: Add Hidden Caret Annotation to PDF Page 4
add-hidden-caret-annotation-to-pdf-page-.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, creating a CaretAnnotation with a subject and the Hidden flag on page 4, and saving the modified document.

add-redaction-annotation-gray-fill.title: Add Redaction Annotation with Gray Fill and Black Border
add-redaction-annotation-gray-fill.description: Loads a PDF, creates a redaction annotation with a gray fill and black border on page 5, adds it to the page, and saves the updated document.

apply-redaction-annotation-with-overlay-.title: Redact PDF Area with Overlay Text
apply-redaction-annotation-with-overlay-.description: Loads a PDF, creates a RedactionAnnotation on a defined rectangle, sets the overlay text to "Confidential" with repeat enabled, adds it to the first page, and saves the redacted document.

redact-pdf-with-redaction-annotation.title: Redact PDF Using RedactionAnnotation
redact-pdf-with-redaction-annotation.description: Loads a PDF, adds a redaction annotation to a page, applies the redaction, and saves the redacted document.

add-goto-link-annotation-to-pdf.title: Add GoTo Link Annotation to PDF
add-goto-link-annotation-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, creating an XYZ explicit destination on page 2, adding a LinkAnnotation with a GoToAction on page 1, and saving the modified document.

add-remote-link-annotation.title: Add Remote GoTo Link Annotation to PDF
add-remote-link-annotation.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, creating a LinkAnnotation that uses a GoToRemoteAction to open another PDF at a specific page, and saving the modified document.

add-mailto-link-annotation.title: Add Mailto Link Annotation to PDF
add-mailto-link-annotation.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, creating a LinkAnnotation with a GoToURIAction that opens a mailto link, and saving the updated document.

add-dashed-border-to-link-annotation.title: Create Link Annotation with Dashed Border
add-dashed-border-to-link-annotation.description: The example loads a PDF, adds a link annotation that points to a URL, sets its border to a 1‑point dashed pattern [3,2], and saves the modified document.

extract-uris-from-pdf-link-annotations.title: Extract URIs from PDF Link Annotations
extract-uris-from-pdf-link-annotations.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through all pages, finds LinkAnnotation objects with a GoToURIAction, collects their URI values, and writes the list to a JSON file.

extract-text-from-link-annotations.title: Extract Text from Link Annotations in PDF
extract-text-from-link-annotations.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through each page's link annotations, extracts the text inside the annotation rectangle using TextAbsorber, and saves the results to a text file.

remove-link-annotations-from-page.title: Remove Link Annotations from a Specific PDF Page
remove-link-annotations-from-page.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, locate page 4, collect all LinkAnnotation objects on that page, delete them, and save the cleaned document.

add-named-destination-and-link-annotatio.title: Add Named Destination and Link Annotation to PDF
add-named-destination-and-link-annotatio.description: Demonstrates how to create a named destination on a specific page, attach a GoToAction link annotation to it, and save the updated PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

set-link-annotation-color-blue-page-7.title: Set Link Annotation Color to Blue on Page 7
set-link-annotation-color-blue-page-7.description: Loads a PDF, finds the first LinkAnnotation on page 7, changes its color to blue, and saves the modified document.

add-caret-annotations-to-multiple-pdf-pa.title: Add Caret Annotations to Multiple PDF Pages
add-caret-annotations-to-multiple-pdf-pa.description: Shows how to load a PDF, create distinct CaretAnnotation objects on pages 1, 2 and 3 with unique titles and contents, and save the modified document.

update-caret-annotation-titles.title: Update Caret Annotation Titles in PDF
update-caret-annotation-titles.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through its pages to find CaretAnnotation objects, prepends "Updated-" to each annotation's Title, and saves the modified document.

redact-entire-page-8.title: Redact Entire Page 8 in PDF
redact-entire-page-8.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, creating a RedactionAnnotation that covers the whole of page 8, disabling repeat, applying the redaction, and saving the result.

apply-redaction-annotation-overlay-text.title: Redact PDF Page with Overlay Text
apply-redaction-annotation-overlay-text.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, adding a RedactionAnnotation with overlay text "Top Secret" on page 9, applying the redaction, and saving the result.

add-goto-link-annotation-xyz-destination.title: Create GoTo Link Annotation with XYZ Destination
add-goto-link-annotation-xyz-destination.description: The example loads an existing PDF, adds a link annotation on the first page that navigates to a specific XYZ destination with a 150% zoom, and saves the updated document.

add-remote-link-annotation-to-pdf.title: Add Remote Link Annotation to PDF
add-remote-link-annotation-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, creating a LinkAnnotation with a GoToRemoteAction that opens an external PDF at a specific page, and saving the modified document.

add-https-link-annotation-to-pdf.title: Add HTTPS Link Annotation to PDF
add-https-link-annotation-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, creating a LinkAnnotation with a GoToURIAction that points to a secure HTTPS URL, and saving the updated document.

set-link-annotation-border-width.title: Set Link Annotation Border Width on Page 5
set-link-annotation-border-width.description: Loads a PDF, finds the first LinkAnnotation on page 5, changes its border width to 2 points, and saves the updated document.

export-dashed-link-annotations-to-csv.title: Export Dashed Link Annotations to CSV
export-dashed-link-annotations-to-csv.description: Loads a PDF, finds LinkAnnotation objects whose border style is dashed, and writes their rectangle coordinates to a CSV file.

extract-text-from-link-annotations-page-.title: Extract Text from Link Annotations on a Specific PDF Page
extract-text-from-link-annotations-page-.description: Loads a PDF, iterates over all LinkAnnotation rectangles on page 10, extracts the text inside each rectangle using a TextFragmentAbsorber, and saves the collected text to a file.

export-redaction-fill-colors-csv.title: Export Redaction Annotation Fill Colors to CSV
export-redaction-fill-colors-csv.description: Loads a PDF, extracts all RedactionAnnotation objects, reads their FillColor values, and writes a CSV report with page number, annotation index, and RGB components.

add-redaction-annotation-red-border-page.title: Add Redaction Annotation with Red Border to PDF Page 11
add-redaction-annotation-red-border-page.description: The example loads a PDF, creates a RedactionAnnotation on page 11 with only the border color set to red, adds it to the page, and saves the modified document.

redact-multiple-pdf-pages-annotations.title: Redact Multiple PDF Pages Using Annotations
redact-multiple-pdf-pages-annotations.description: Loads a PDF, adds redaction annotations on different pages, invokes Redact() for each annotation, and saves the redacted document.

extract-caret-annotation-flags-to-csv.title: Extract Caret Annotation Flags to CSV
extract-caret-annotation-flags-to-csv.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through all pages, extracts every CaretAnnotation, reads its Flags bitmask, and writes the page number, annotation index and flag value to a CSV report.

redact-pdf-area-light-blue.title: Redact PDF Area with Light Blue Fill
redact-pdf-area-light-blue.description: Loads a PDF, adds a RedactionAnnotation with a light‑blue fill color, applies the redaction, and saves the result.

add-goto-link-annotation-dashed-border.title: Add GoTo Link Annotation with Dashed Border to PDF
add-goto-link-annotation-dashed-border.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, creating a LinkAnnotation that navigates to another page using GoToAction, applying a dashed border of width 1, and saving the modified document.

set-link-annotation-color-to-green.title: Set Link Annotation Color to Green
set-link-annotation-color-to-green.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through its pages to find link annotations, changes each annotation's color to green, and saves the updated document.

flatten-pdf-annotations__v3.title: Flatten PDF Annotations
flatten-pdf-annotations__v3.description: Opens a PDF, iterates through each page's annotations, flattens them into the page content, and saves the result as AnnotationsFlattened.pdf.

flatten-all-annotations-in-pdf.title: Flatten All Annotations in a PDF
flatten-all-annotations-in-pdf.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through each page, flattens every annotation using Annotation.Flatten(), and saves the result as a new PDF.
